variant.prompt: production prompt plus temp-only, no-network, cleanup instructions

protocol.order_policy: independently randomized arm order; raw bytes and mappings retained
protocol.prompt_policy: The task/query bytes and model settings match within each pair. The variant's internal scout preamble differs only by the experiment-required temp-only instructions; the current preamble is unchanged.
protocol.cache_policy: new mktemp HOME and CODEX_HOME per trial; auth.json and provider config copied; Codex scout uses --ignore-user-config and --ephemeral
protocol.network_policy: provider access only; scout browser/apps/network tools disabled and prompt forbids network
protocol.repository_write_policy: scout-only trials compare exact pre/post git status; Sol runs use separate clones; scout is the first repository operation
protocol.billing_source: codex-lb request_logs rows bracketed by request id for each sequential trial

invalid_attempts.reason: codex exec omitted -C clone; both arms edited one shared worktree and the second inherited the first patch
